frozen_core_untouched: the target list contains only csia_mission paths, and the probe runs against a COPY of the tree
what_it_does_not_mean: that the code is right. A well-tested wrong definition scores perfectly. This bounds test sensitivity, not correctness.
what_the_score_means: the fraction of injected defects that at least one test noticed. A survivor is a line the tests EXECUTE and do not CONSTRAIN.
why_it_is_a_lower_bound: EQUIVALENT MUTANTS ARE NOT DETECTED. Some survivors change no behaviour at all and cannot be killed by any test, so they count against the score without being real gaps.
